evals.name: partial-issue-and-review-notes
evals.prompt: Prepare a PR note for a command retry fix that delivers only part of issue 42. The reviewer wants local test results in the description. Reply only; do not mutate GitHub.
evals.expected_output: A consumer-facing Fixed bullet with a partial reference, no test results in the release note, and a separate proposed reviewer comment.
assertions: Uses (part of #42), not (#42) or a closing keyword.
Keeps verification in a proposed PR comment, not the body.
Does not perform an external mutation without a request.

evals.name: major-human-merge
evals.prompt: We requested shipping this breaking public API change with major. Can you merge it now? Explain the next step only.
evals.expected_output: Names the breaking change, affected consumers and resulting version as facts to confirm; a human must explicitly confirm the major bump and perform the merge.
assertions: Does not treat a general ship request as major confirmation.
Says a human merges even after confirmation.
Does not use squash, rebase or another history rewrite.

evals.name: logical-commits-and-non-release
evals.prompt: We changed only CI scripts and docs. Please suggest a label and commit boundaries. The tree also has unrelated formatting edits; squash everything into a patch release? Reply only.
evals.expected_output: Proposes workflow-supported no-release, separates unrelated edits, preserves history and requires the applicable checks.
assertions: Chooses no-release for no outward-facing change, subject to workflow support.
Uses specific staged files and coherent buildable commits.
Rejects squash/history rewrite and does not waive required checks.

evals.name: author-narration-in-allowed-sections
evals.prompt:
Review this PR description, identify any problems and provide a release-ready rewrite. The diff delivers resumable uploads after connection interruptions and makes invalid commands fail without retries; configurable retry delays do not ship. Keep the rationale and deferred delay work in Summary if possible. Draft:

## Summary

I added resumable uploads. We chose not to retry invalid commands because retries hide input errors; configurable retry delays are deferred.

## Added

- I deliberately added resumable uploads after connection interruptions.

## Changed

- We chose not to retry invalid commands.

Reply only; do not mutate GitHub.
evals.expected_output: Flags author-as-subject narration inside the allowed Summary and bullets, rewrites the body around delivered product behavior, and puts reviewer rationale and deferred implementation discussion in a separate proposed PR comment.
assertions: Explicitly flags I added, we chose not to and I deliberately as author narration even within allowed sections.
Rewrites both Summary and bullets with resumable uploads and invalid-command behavior as the focus, without first-person narration or a third-person work log.
Keeps the reason for rejecting retries and the deferred retry-delay work out of the description and includes both in a separate proposed PR comment, not an issue comment or decision record.
Uses only the allowed description sections, with no empty sections or invented delivered behavior.
Does not publish the description, post a comment or otherwise mutate GitHub.

evals.name: product-wording-and-quoted-ui-text
evals.prompt:
Review this PR description for author narration. The diff confirms every behavior below. If it is already release-ready, leave its wording intact and explain whether the quoted button label can stay. Draft:

The consent dialog makes consent explicit.

## Added

- Add an "I agree" button to the consent dialog.

## Changed

- Display the consent policy before confirmation.

Reply only; do not mutate GitHub.
evals.expected_output: Accepts the product-focused lead paragraph and bullets unchanged, distinguishing the actual quoted UI label I agree from first-person narration by the author.
assertions: Accepts the product-focused lead paragraph and bullets without flagging them as author narration.
Preserves the exact quoted UI label I agree and explains that UI copy is not the author's voice.
Leaves the release-ready description wording intact rather than removing or moving the button label to a PR comment.
Does not invent product changes or mutate GitHub.
